scenes.heading: Building a media kit that gets you taken seriously

sents.d: Building a media kit that gets you taken seriously
A professional media kit signals you run this as a business, not a hobby.

scenes.heading: What goes in a media kit

sents.d: A media kit typically includes your audience size and demographics across platforms, average engagement rates, examples of past brand work if available, and your rates or a note that rates are available on request.

Presenting real numbers honestly — including areas that aren't your strongest — builds more credibility with brands than inflated or cherry-picked statistics that don't hold up under basic verification.
Updating the media kit regularly (at minimum every few months) ensures you're never sending outdated numbers to a potential brand partner, which can undercut your actual current value.

take: Keep an honest, current media kit ready to send.
